title: Trade
description: trade/v2: the document a trade-booked (venue) or trade-proposed (party, in-app) event carries, the affirmed economics of one repo trade. The event's own id is the trade's key; every later event about the trade cites it.

tradeRef.description: Venue or app reference of the trade.

agreementVersion.description: Agreement version whose terms the trade was booked under.

assetId.description: FinP2P asset id of the currency.
FinP2P asset id of the currency.

repurchasePrice.description: Leg 2: cash A pays B at maturity.

rate.description: Repo rate as a decimal string (0.0425 = 4.25%).

quantity.description: Units of this line the trade pledges; absent when the booking carries the category only.

price.description: Unit price of this line before the haircut, in the trade's cash currency, as the venue booked it. Required on every line of a platform booking with several lines, which are valued per line.

collateral.description: Eligible securities and haircuts for THIS trade; a subset of the agreement's eligibleAssets.

collateralMode.description: Where the collateral sits for the term: delivered into the receiver's account by the loan plan (lender-account), held on the pledger's account with the receiver as beneficiary (segregated), or moved into the trade's provisioned container (controlled, the basket shape). An external pair (external) holds the collateral on the calculation agent's own platform: FinP2P sees only the basket token it registers and the cash.

settlement.description: The cash accounts the legs settle on; what the settlement plan is built from.

assetId.description: FinP2P asset id of the cash this side settles on.

address.description: The wallet address on that chain.

networkAccount.description: Optional. The wallet this side uses on the collateral platform, for this trade only. It is set once and never changed. On a booked trade the venue may name both sides' wallets. On a proposed trade each party names its own in its trade-affirmed instead, and the facade refuses one here unless the proposer holds both sides. When absent, the pair's address book applies, else there is none.

assetId.description: FinP2P asset id of the cash this side settles on.

On a proposed trade each party names its own in its trade-affirmed instead, and the facade refuses one here unless the proposer holds both sides. When absent, the pair's address book applies, else there is none.

venueAffirmation.description: A venue booking's record of the match: documentary, the guards do not read it.

settlementTime.description: Epoch milliseconds the open leg settles at; the settlement plan is built from it. openDate is the calendar day for the record.

maturityTime.description: Epoch milliseconds the close leg runs at; closeDate is the calendar day for the record.
